method: Exact replay of stored per-attack outcomes (qwen3.8-27b vault, temperature 0, guard v2): tightening only turns passes into blocks, so leaked' = leaked and not newly blocked. Block decisions at the old thresholds reproduce 216/216 and 110/110. Vault run-to-run variance is not modelled (live check on the prefix that completed: boss 2 first 47 attacks 5 leaks live vs 6 replay; boss 3 first 84 attacks 4 live vs 8 replay with rounded scores, exact scores used here).

iteration_2_(secret|access) code (+34 bl.verdict: closest to band (0.8 points above 55), chosen

L2.shipped: wall = previous wall with DAN restored + (secret|access) code

iteration_1_val_ASR_28%_threshold_0.9999.verdict: in band pooled; chosen (the owner's val-ASR rule)

iteration_2_threshold_0.99997143_(val_AS.verdict: above the band pooled; not chosen

L4_L5: unchanged (0/216 and 0/110 leaks on the qwen vault)
caveat: 0% on templated attacks is not 'unbreakable': human players will find gaps. With the gpt-oss-20b vault bosses 2 and 3 leak less than with qwen (partial 20b numbers in ADR-0097), so they may sit below their bands when 20b answers.
